product: MODIS Terra L3 · monthly NDVI (NASA GIBS MODIS_Terra_L3_NDVI_Monthly layer, cell mean)
processing: NDVI recovered from the image using the official GIBS palette (142 classes from 0.005 to 0.01 wide) and area-averaged to 2°. Transparent pixels (water, no data, or NDVI less than or equal to 0) are excluded. Months not published by GIBS: 2025-04.
citation: Didan, K. (2021). MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V061. NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC. doi:10.5067/MODIS/MOD13A3.061. Imagery served by NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), ESDIS.
